# neoOptimizied
**neoOptimizied is a optimization modpack with just OPTIMIZATION mods.**

(it has some **QoL** features too)

This modpack is mostly just optimization with some resource packs to make **YOUR** gameplay a bit better and for the sake of your framerates.

NeoOptimizied aims to help your minecraft experience way better, with QOL features and many optimization mods. NeoOptimized also helps to make sure that your framerates stay high.

NeoOptimizied is made by strapig, only on modrinth and licensed with the [Apache License](https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.html).
